title: Inside the Plague Research Labs at the Heart of a Russian Mystery
summary_full: A Russian researcher, who died from an unknown illness, worked at a remote anti-plague facility. Few foreigners have visited these labs, which dot the former Soviet states, and are shrouded in secrecy.
